projectDescription: A node-based AI studio for generating campaign-level images and videos — wire products, characters, styles, and environments into visual workflows, then generate coherent campaign sets without writing a single prompt.
keyFeatures: Node-based visual canvas for building AI generation workflows
Prompt-free image and video generation from connected asset nodes
Asset libraries for products, characters, styles, and environments
Campaign-level batch generation with visual consistency across all outputs
Reusable workflow templates and a public gallery to clone and remix
Normal and Pro image quality models
Priority generation queue on paid plans
Monthly credit system with rollover and one-time top-ups
publicApiSurface: Projects tab — canvas workspace for building and saving node workflows
Workflows tab — browse, clone, and manage workflow configurations
Assets tab — upload and manage products, characters, styles, and environments
Manage Plan tab — subscription management, credit balance, billing
Settings tab — account preferences and configuration
Generate button — trigger batch image or video generation from a workflow
Public gallery — browse and clone community workflows
Template presets — Fashion Shooting, Product Still Life, UGC Content
